shots: Rainy Soviet courtyard at dusk, heavy rust-orange rain, a silent crowd of pale infected people with orange-veined faces and empty eyes all slowly turn their heads toward the camera, seen from behind a small figure in a yellow raincoat far in the foreground.
Extreme close-up of a wet dark braid tied with an orange hair tie, a single rust-orange water drop hanging from its tip, rain blur behind.
Close-up of a small child's boot stepping backwards into an orange puddle, big splash of rust-colored water, rain.
A crowd of infected people with orange-streaked skin and blank stares walking slowly through rust-orange rain toward the camera, Soviet panel buildings behind.
{NURLAN} firmly holds the hand of {MIRA} in the rain, he raises a finger to his lips signalling silence, rusty rain around them.
Low angle shot of a man's work boots and a child's small boots carefully stepping around orange puddles on a wet street.
{NURLAN} takes off his grey work jacket and covers {MIRA} with it over her head, rust-orange rain pouring down.
Close-up portrait of {NURLAN} soaked through by rust-orange rain, water streaming down his round glasses and face, determined expression.
{NURLAN} and {MIRA} slowly walk into the entrance of a looted dark supermarket with broken glass doors, rain outside.
Infected people with orange-veined faces stand motionless in the rust-orange rain outside the broken supermarket doors, confused, looking around.
Under a checkout counter in a dark supermarket, a plastic crate of sealed water bottles lit by a flashlight beam.
Extreme close-up of a plastic water bottle cap with its safety ring torn off, flashlight light, dark background.
{MIRA} drinks water from a sealed plastic bottle, sitting on the floor of a dark supermarket, {NURLAN} watches her kindly.
{MIRA} holds out a water bottle to {NURLAN}, he gently pushes it back toward her and smiles, dim supermarket interior.
{MIRA} asleep leaning on the shoulder of {NURLAN}, they sit against a shelf in a dark supermarket, rain streaks on the high window above.
Extreme close-up of a man's forearm with a rolled-up wet grey sleeve, glowing rust-orange veins spreading from the wrist toward the elbow, dark moody light.
